name: Daniel Moreno
office: City of Norwalk, Member of the City Council

items.text: Daniel Moreno is an environmental advocate. His campaign focuses on expanding green spaces and urban shade, transparent and accessible governance for working families, and protecting streets and modernizing transit. He opposes the use of Flock cameras and the construction of data centers in Norwalk, and promotes building green, car-lite public infrastructure.
